Misc. 414/40.
Gordon Road
August 19th, 40.
Activities of secret agents of No.76 Jessfield Road in the
International Settlement.
D.S.I. Tao Keng Yong.
Officer i/c.

Sir,

at 5 p.m. on 19/8/40 C.P.C. 826 brought to
the station three male Chinese namely:-
(1) Yung Ying Dong (楊堂), 17, Chekiang,
S/Student, 5 Yoong Zung Li, Gordon Road.
(2) Yao Ding Liang (姚定样), 23, Shanghai,
S/Agent, 81 Edinburgh Road.
(3) Pao Yu Yung (包育文), 20, Shanghai,
S/Agent, 81 Edinburgh Road.
the No.2 & 3 being alleged by the No.1 to have
attempted to kidnap him.

On being questioned, the 2nd and 3rd named
above
claimed them as Secret agents of the Association
of the United Schools at 81 Edinburgh Road and stated
that the 1st named presided over a Communist Meeting
at the Kwang Zih (光實) Primary School at No.14
Lane 367 Connaught Road where one other male and 3
female Chinese students were participating. An
immediate visit was made to the school where the
following persons were located and brought to the
station for enquiries:-
(4) Si Ying Hai (施文海), 20, Shanghai,
S/Agent, 81 Edinburgh Road.
(5) Yao Lao Ming (饒召民), 17, Kiangsu,
S/Student, 291 King Hsin Li, Seymour Road.
(6) Hsu Ih Ping (許一冰), 19, Wusih,
S/Female Student, 18/713 Sinsa Road.
(7) Wang Hsin Sin (王新心), 18, Nanking,
S/Female Student, 11 Sing Hsin Li, S'well Rd.

先生，

1940年8月19日下午5时，华捕826号将三名中国男子带至警局，即：
(1) 杨堂（Yung Ying Dong），17岁，浙江籍，
学生，住戈登路永宗里5号。
(2) 姚定样（Yao Ding Liang），23岁，上海籍，
特工，住爱丁堡路81号。
(3) 包育文（Pao Yu Yung），20岁，上海籍，
特工，住爱丁堡路81号。
据第1人称，第2、3人曾企图绑架他。

经讯问，上述第2和第3人
声称他们是爱丁堡路81号“联合学校协会”的秘密特工，并指称
第1人在康纳路367弄14号光实（Kwang Zih）小学主持了一次共产党会议，另有
一名中国男学生和三名中国女学生参加。警方随即前往该学校，
找到以下人员并带至警局接受查询：
(4) 施文海（Si Ying Hai），20岁，上海籍，
特工，住爱丁堡路81号。
(5) 饶召民（Yao Lao Ming），17岁，江苏籍，
学生，住西摩路金辛里291号。
(6) 许一冰（Hsu Ih Ping），19岁，无锡籍，
女学生，住新闸路713弄18号。
(7) 王新心（Wang Hsin Sin），18岁，南京籍，
女学生，住斯威尔路（S'well Rd.）新心里11号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Koo Ts Nyi ( 顧子宜 )
native of Nanwei taken by me D.S.I. Golder
at Police H.Q. on the 21.8.40 translated Clerk Hsu Ta Yung
and interpreted by Clerk Hsu Ta Yung

My name is Koo Ts Nyi ( 顧子宜 ), age 34 native
of Nanwei, Pootung. I was graduate from the Kwang Hwa
University in 1928 and am at present a faculty member
of the following schools :-
1) Kwong Shih Middle School, 359 Connaught Rd.
2) Wei Ling Middle School, 336 Gordon Rd. and
3) Chuen Nyih Middle School, L.H. Tse Soh Building,
Nanking Rd.

Following the commencement of the summer vacation
in June, the students of the graduation class of the
Wei Ling Middle School have conducted supplementary
classes to the young members of the said school on the
premises of the Kwong Shih Middle School, aforesaid,
through my introduction, without requiring payment of
any rental. ( I have done so under the commital of
the young members - Junior 2nd - of the Wei Ling Middle
School). I did not know that the students of the
Wei Ling Middle School held a meeting of a political
nature in the Kwong Shih Middle School on 19.8.40
nor have I any knowledge that they intend fostering
anti-Wang Ching Wei sentiments among the students.

Signed : Koo Ts Nyi

以下为顾子宜（Koo Ts Nyi）的陈述，
籍贯南汇，由本人警佐 Golder 于1940年8月21日
在警察总部录取，由办事员徐达庸翻译
并由办事员徐达庸口译

我叫顾子宜（Koo Ts Nyi），34岁，籍贯浦东南汇。我于1928年毕业于光华大学，目前任教于以下学校：
1) 光实中学，康纳路359号。
2) 位灵中学，戈登路336号。以及
3) 泉益中学，南京路李泽索大楼（L.H. Tse Soh Building）。

继六月暑假开始后，位灵中学毕业班学生
经我介绍，在上述光实中学校址内，为该校低年级成员举办补习班，
未收取任何租金。（我是受位灵中学低年级成员——初中二年级——之托而为之）。我并不知道位灵中学学生于1940年8月19日在光实中学举行具有政治性质的会议，也不知道他们意图在学生中培养反汪精卫情绪。

签名：顾子宜

Subject Assistance to Gordon Road Station in the matter of the arrest of
four middle school students.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by D.S.I. Logan

At 5.50 p.m. August 19, 1940, a message was
received from Gordon Road through C.D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa,
Special Branch, to the effect that a number of middle
school students had been arrested following an
altercation with alleged agents of the Special Service
Section, No. 76 Jessfield Road.

Inquiries carried out at the request of the
station by the undersigned, D.S. McKeown, Clerk Chin
Ching Hai and C.D.C. 360 revealed the following :-

At approximately 4 p.m., students namely
YANG YING DONG (楊棠), YAO ZAO MING (饒召民),
HSU IH PING (許一冰), WONG YU SHU (王玉書) and
one other who did not attend the station, of the Wei
Ling Middle School situated at 336 Gordon Road had
just finished teaching the young members of the Kwang
Shih Middle School (光實中學) on the Kwang Shih
premises, 359 Connaught Road, and were holding a meeting
on the present political situation in China, their
political sympathies being with the Chungking Regime,
when they were interrupted by the intrusion of three
students of the Central University, (pro-Wang Ching Wei)
namely Pao You Wen (包有文), Yao Ding Liang (姚庭)
and Sz Wen Hai (施文海)

These three intruders, who besides being
students are members of the "Educational Section" of
the Intelligence Office, No. 81 Edinburgh Road,

主题 协助戈登路警局处理逮捕四名中学生一事。

由 警佐 Golder 呈报 经由 警佐 Logan 转呈

1940年8月19日下午5时50分，通过特别股华探库宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa）收到来自戈登路警局的消息，称数名中学生在与极司菲尔路76号特务科所谓特工发生争执后被捕。

应警局要求，由本人、警司 McKeown、办事员陈青海（Chin Ching Hai）和华捕360号进行的调查揭示如下情况：

下午4时许，位于戈登路336号的位灵中学学生，即杨棠（YANG YING DONG）、饶召民（YAO ZAO MING）、许一冰（HSU IH PING）、王玉书（WONG YU SHU）及另一名未到警局者，刚刚在康纳路359号的光实中学（光實中學）校舍内教完光实中学的低年级学生，正在举行关于中国当前政治局势的会议，他们的政治同情倾向于重庆政权，此时遭到三名中央大学学生（亲汪精卫派）的闯入打断，这三名学生分别是包有文（Pao You Wen）、姚庭（Yao Ding Liang）和施文海（Sz Wen Hai）。

这三名闯入者除了是学生外，还是爱丁堡路81号情报局“教育科”的成员，

attempted to hold the four other students but were
unsuccessful. One Yang Ying Dong managed to make
good his escape and inform C.P.C. 826, who was in the
vicinity. As a result four of the persons present
at the meeting were taken to Gordon Road Station by
the C.P.C., whilst the three members of the Central
University followed of the own volition.
        The four members of the Wei Ling School in
custody openly admitted that they were opposed to
the Nanking Regime and were holding a meeting to
foster anti-Wang sentiment among the students. On the
other hand the three members of the Central University
were not slow to admit that they were Wang's
adherents.
        It was claimed in the statements of the
three Central University students that they were
visiting a friend one Chow Wei Shao (周滙滿) at the
Yoh Tsing Middle School, which is situated opposite
the Kwang Shih Middle School, when they observed the
meeting in progress. It is more than probable however
that Chow Wei Shao had previously observed the
meeting and being admittedly an adherent of the Wang
Regime had informed his friends in the Intelligence
Section.
        The salient factors of the case were
related to D.O. "B" at 11 p.m. August 19, when he
instructed that in the absence of any specific charge

        被拘留的四名位灵中学成员公开承认他们反对南京政权，并正在举行会议以在学生中培养反汪情绪。另一方面，三名中央大学成员也不迟地承认他们是汪精卫的追随者。
        在三名中央大学学生的供词中，他们声称当时正去拜访位于光实中学对面的约青中学（Yoh Tsing Middle School）的一位朋友周滙满（Chow Wei Shao），期间观察到会议正在进行。然而，极有可能的是，周滙满此前已观察到会议，且既然公认是汪伪政权的追随者，他便通知了他在情报科的朋友。

(A) Nature of work --- To improve the livelihood of schoolmates.
(B) Policy to deal with the enemy and the puppets --- To
    deal with traitors, the Wang Ching-wei clique and the
    San Tsing.    Struggles of thoughts.    To try to avoid
    direct clashes.    Ways and means to carry on spiritual
    directions.    Not to form any particular anti-Wang
    Ching-wei organization in the name of the Association
    of Classes.
(D) Policy ---    To decide the policy according to circumstances,
    and to have an accurate understanding.    Do not follow
    blindly the views of the public.
(E) Policy of the units ---    Those who are faithful to this
    Association may join the units.

(A) 工作性质 --- 改善同学生活。
(B) 对付敌人与傀儡的政策 --- 对付汉奸、汪精卫集团及三青团。    思想斗争。    尽量避免直接冲突。    进行精神指导的方式和方法。    不以班级协会的名义组建任何特定的反汪精卫组织。
(D) 政策 ---    根据情况决定政策，并保持准确的理解。    不盲目跟随公众观点。
(E) 各单位政策 ---    忠于本协会者可加入各单位。
